curated.note: Hand-curated against commit e031523. Not model-produced; verified_by_agent stays false. Covers LarkRuntimeHost wiring; realtime event ingestion is a separate seed.

module_responsibilities: Owns the long-running Lark host loop: syncs connection state, processes due turns, and recovers unfinished assistant turns.
Binds chat visibility policy and hands inbound conversations to the AssistantRuntime.
boundaries: Does not itself parse webhook events (that is realtime.ts) or deliver cards (delivery.ts).
Read in review mode only: it is not started by the review app and needs credentials.

key_flows.name: host-loop
key_flows.description: start() launches loop(); processOnce() runs syncConnections and then processes due turns.

risks_and_limits: Requires Lark app credentials and network; review mode never starts this host.
Connection sync state is persisted externally and not modeled as raw graph here.
unknowns: Real webhook traffic, token refresh and retry behavior are not exercised offline.

claims.text: syncConnections reconciles active Lark connections against stored leases

evidence.text: External notifications and OS services are separate explicit integrations; no global hooks/listeners without concrete scope.
